name: Intrinio
tagline: Institutional-grade fundamentals, options, and real-time market data API
description: Intrinio provides financial market data APIs covering equities, options, fundamentals, company filings, and real-time/delayed market data for developers and institutions.

auth.details: API key authentication; exact header/query mechanism needs verification from official docs

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free, limited Developer Sandbox for testing; its data may be incomplete or outdated and is not for production. Intrinio also advertises free two-week trials on most datasets; production access generally requires a paid subscription.

rate_limits: Feed-dependent daily, per-minute, and per-second limits apply. Large-page and bulk requests: free 1/minute, paid 1/second. Free-data-only accounts: 100 requests/second. Requests time out after 25 seconds.
use_cases: get company fundamentals for a ticker
fetch options chain data for a stock
